name: Md Zahid Hasan
subject: Re: Speaking Invitation: Global Developer Summit 2027
body:
Dear Alexandre,

Thank you for considering me for the keynote speaker opportunity at DevSummit 2027.

I'm honored by the invitation and interested in learning more about the event and the Full-Stack Systems track.

Could you please share the official event website, proposed dates and location, speaker deck, and more details about the keynote expectations?

I'd also appreciate information about speaker arrangements, including compensation, travel, and accommodation support.

Looking forward to learning more about this opportunity.

Best regards,
Zahid

name: Md Zahid Hasan
subject: Re: Tech Advisory & Full-Stack Consultation
body:
Hi David,

Thanks for reaching out and considering me for the consulting opportunity.

The areas you mentioned, particularly Next.js architecture, scalable authentication, edge caching, and modern development infrastructure, sound interesting.

I'd be open to exploring a potential engagement. Could you share more details about TechVentures, the startups you're working with, the expected scope of consulting, and the anticipated time commitment and budget?

I'd be happy to review the details and see if there's a good fit.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Zahid

name: Sarah Lin
subject: Project Collaboration: AI-Driven Design System & Web App
body:
Hi Zahid,

I came across your portfolio and was blown away by the craftsmanship of your tactile UI components and full-stack architecture. We are currently architecting an AI agent workflow platform at Apex Studio and need a lead frontend / full-stack engineer who understands design systems, real-time sync, and Supabase integration.

Could we schedule a 20-minute intro call this week to discuss scope, timeline, and rates?

Best regards,
Sarah Lin
Head of Engineering @ Apex Studio

name: David Miller
subject: Tech Advisory & Full-Stack Consultation
body:
Hey Zahid,

Hope you're doing well! We are reviewing several early-stage dev-tools startups in our portfolio that are looking for advisory on Next.js 15 App Router architecture, edge caching, and scalable authentication patterns.

Your profile stood out given your track record with modern web infrastructure and agentic tooling. Let me know if you have bandwidth for a consulting engagement this quarter.

Cheers,
David Miller
Partner, TechVentures

name: Alexandre Dumas
subject: Speaking Invitation: Global Developer Summit 2027
body:
Dear Zahid,

We would love to invite you as a keynote speaker for the Full-Stack Systems track at DevSummit 2027. We noticed your public engineering work on GitHub and thought your experience building tactile UI frameworks and real-time portfolio architecture would be immensely valuable to our 4,000+ attendees.

Please let us know if you'd be interested and we'll send over the speaker deck.

Warm regards,
Alexandre Dumas

name: Md Zahid Hasan
subject: Re: Architecture Review for Micro-frontends on Vercel
body:
Hi Marcus,

Thanks for reaching out! I reviewed the RFC you shared. The separation of concerns between your auth service and dashboard microfrontends looks solid. I added inline annotations on the edge routing middleware and cache headers.

Looking forward to sync on Thursday.

Best,
Zahid
